title: quercus marilandica f. integrifolia
intro: Quercus marilandica f. integrifolia, commonly known as the white oak, is a deciduous tree native to North America. It is valued for its timber and medicinal properties, particularly in traditional herbal medicine. The health benefits of Quercus marilandica f. integrifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an astringent, demulcent, and vulnerary, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
